publishedDeadlines.note: Annual undated date; not explicitly confirmed Fall 2027.

applicationFee.note: International $75, domestic $60. Current Purdue students and degree alumni of West Lafayette/Indianapolis, Fort Wayne and Northwest receive automatic waiver by listing institution (October 26, 2026 policy). Listed recruitment/affiliation routes require specific participation, sometimes visiting recruiter/contact card; one waiver per participation. Economic hardship email route requires US citizenship/PR. International applicants must confirm relevant affiliation eligibility.

english.note: Legacy sections W18/S18/L14/R19; new W4/S3.5/L3.5/R4. IELTS sections R6.5/L6/S6/W5.5; One Skill Retake excluded. DET115 overall and each integrated subscore, not individual skill subscores. Official tests within two years at recommendation. Home/Paper Edition accepted, MyBest excluded; central Essentials8 each/overall subject to programme acceptance. Routine degree exemption requires English-primary institution in listed native-English country/location and degree within 36 months; programme may still require test. Current Purdue waiver also requires prior proficiency and admission recommendation within three registration sessions.

documents: Transcripts and English translations when applicable
requirements.note: GPA at least 3.0 from most recently conferred undergraduate, graduate or professional degree. GRE optional, but specific faculty or clinical residencies may require it: confirm before submission. Spring admission exceptional; international October 1, US citizen December 1; summer international February 1/US citizen May 1. DVM is separate; clinical/anatomic/avian pathology residency applicants use appropriate non-thesis MS/residency.

funding.note: Programme-specific support, amount and guarantee not established from accessible sources; confirm funding before accepting an offer.
